item.name: Get all breaches for an account

request.name: Get all breaches for an account

description.content: Available on Core, Pro, and High RPM subscriptions. Returns the breaches for the supplied account (email address, username, or phone number). The account is not case-sensitive and is trimmed of leading or trailing whitespace. The account should always be URL encoded. This is an authenticated API requiring both the hibp-api-key and user-agent headers. Test API keys can be used to query test accounts on the hibp-integration-tests.com domain.

query.description: Returns the full breach model when false. By default, only the name of the breach is returned rather than the complete breach data.
Filters the result set to only breaches against the domain specified. It is possible that one site (and consequently domain), is compromised on multiple occasions.
Returns breaches that have been flagged as 'unverified'. By default, both verified and unverified breaches are returned when performing a search.

header.description: (Required) User agent string identifying the consuming application. Required on all documented requests, including unauthenticated endpoints; missing user agents may receive HTTP 403 responses.

response.name: A list of breaches for the account. By default the response is truncated to only the breach name. Set truncateResponse=false to receive the full breach model. Sensitive and retired breaches are not returned by the public API.

description.content: Available on Pro and High RPM subscriptions. Search breached accounts via k-anonymity by providing the first 6 characters of the SHA-1 hash of a normalised email address. The response contains matching hash suffixes and associated breach names after public filtering. Sensitive and retired breaches are not returned. description.content: Free Pwned Passwords range search using k-anonymity. This endpoint does not require authentication and is not rate limited, but it still requires a user-agent header. Provide the first 5 characters of either a SHA-1 or NTLM hash to receive matching suffixes and prevalence counts.

query.description: Returns NTLM hash suffixes when set to 'ntlm'. When the mode is not specified or is any value other than 'ntlm', the resulting hashes will be in SHA-1 form.

variable.description: (Required) First 5 characters of a SHA-1 or NTLM hash (hexadecimal, not case-sensitive)

header.description: (Required) User agent string identifying the consuming application. Required on all documented requests, including unauthenticated endpoints; missing user agents may receive HTTP 403 responses.
Adds random padding to Pwned Passwords responses (discard padded entries with count of 0).

response.name: Hash suffixes and prevalence counts. Each line contains a hash suffix followed by a colon and the count of how many times the password appears in the data set. Padded entries (when Add-Padding is used) always have a count of 0 and should be discarded.

info.name: Have I Been Pwned API v3

description.content: Version 3 of the Have I Been Pwned API. Authenticated APIs for breaches by account, pastes, domain search, domain verification, stealer logs, and subscription status require both the hibp-api-key and user-agent headers. Availability varies by subscription tier and is noted per operation. The Pwned Passwords range API is free and does not require authentication.
